title: Mystic Wizard at the Window
description: A hooded wizard in a flowing purple and green robe stands at a wooden desk overlooking a fantastical night landscape. The desk is covered with scrolls, an open spellbook emitting blue magic, a mortar with glowing ingredients, a red wax seal, golden scales, potion bottles, and hanging lanterns against a backdrop of aurora borealis and a red comet streaking across the starry sky.
prompt: A hooded wizard in ornate purple and green robes stands at a cluttered wooden desk inside a tower, studying glowing magical artifacts. The desk holds an open spellbook with floating blue runes, a mortar and pestle with glowing green and blue ingredients, scrolls, a red wax seal stamp, golden scales, and potion vials. Through a large arched window behind him, a dramatic night sky displays green and purple aurora borealis, a bright red comet, and distant mountains under a starry cosmos, with hanging ornate lanterns and purple banners.
